name: conversation-find
title: Conversation Find
description: Ctrl/⌘F searches a whole mounted conversation’s DOM text, including folded parts and content-visibility-skipped messages. Reveals hidden=until-found folds with beforematch (closed folds hold only their text, FoldFindText, not their content) and clipped parts with revealmatch, draws up to 1000 matches in greys ("1 of 1000+"), and returns focus on close. Its words are labels. In a windowed MessageScroller it has every message mounted while open (useMessageScrollerShowAll); messages the app has not rendered and deferred steps not loaded yet are outside the search. Without CSS highlights, count, navigation, reveal and scroll still work.
